rule: AMC-W1 no unseeded randomness, wall clock or hash() in render code
AMC-C3 text >= 4.5:1 on every board (accent >= 3:1, large type only)
AMC-C3 accent colour as text only at >= 76 px on these boards
AMC-N4 nothing appears before the voice names it (no negative offsets)
AMC-S2 no coin / ding / cash sounds (owner)
AMC-E1 every map shows a change (route, flight, fill, date or 2+ pins)
AMC-N2 sentence > 20 words gets two pictures
AMC-N3 0.5 s pause after a question
